description: The landing page has no Sign up / Get started control. The only prominent action is Copy for the agent line. A visitor who wants an account must guess that Sign in covers sign-up, or go to Pricing.
expected: A visible 'Sign up' or 'Start free' action in the header and hero (or the pricing teaser on the landing page).
actual: Header: Docs, Pricing, llms.txt, Sign in, Console. The landing pricing teaser has only 'See full pricing'. Start with Free exists only on /pricing.
suggested_fix: Add 'Start free' to the header and put a 'Start with Free' button in the landing pricing teaser.

description: At 390px width the landing page header shows only the logo. Docs, Pricing, llms.txt, Sign in and Console all have zero width and there is no menu button, so a phone visitor cannot sign in or reach pricing without scrolling to the footer.
expected: A collapsed menu, or at least Sign in visible, in the header on narrow screens.
actual: Header nav is hidden; links exist only in the footer (~5,500px down).
suggested_fix: Show Sign in (and Pricing) in the mobile header, or add a menu toggle.

description: The not-configured /sign-in and /sign-up cards have no link to each other, to the home page or to docs. (Only seen because Clerk is unset locally; a real deployment shows Clerk's form.)
expected: At least a link back home and between sign-in and sign-up.
actual: Text-only card with the small logo as the only exit.
suggested_fix: Add 'Back to home' and cross-links to the fallback cards.

description: Header navigation differs between the landing page and /pricing: landing has Docs and a plain 'Console' link; pricing has no Docs and an outlined 'Open console' button. Price formatting also differs ($0 vs $0.00).
expected: One header and one price format across marketing pages.
actual: Two different headers and number formats.
suggested_fix: Share one marketing header component and one price formatter.
